Definition: to be alert, i.e. sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to wake, watch, awake, be alert; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to keep watch of, be wakeful over; 1a2) to be wakeful, wake (as mourner or sufferer)
